name: konyklabs-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for expensive-model sessions on a budget: the governor harness, and domain skills for Python test engineering.

plugins.name: governor
plugins.description: Token guardrails for sessions on Fable-tier models: pins spawns to cheap workers, denies forks, requires a brief for expensive spawns, prices a per-session budget from the transcript, and holds workers to an evidence contract.

plugins.name: py-testing
plugins.description: Python test engineering skills — pytest project structure, Playwright API and browser tests, SQLAlchemy test fixtures — and the untangling workflow for large unmerged test suites.
